items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; missed practices, expected sidelined.
items.why: Hamstring; consecutive missed practices and sources indicate no go.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thinned; Hurts targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining PHI pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR with hamstring injury; will miss at least 4 games, no surgery needed.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirms IR path.
items.implication: Saints RB committee shifts heavily to remaining backs for next month-plus.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles after limited practice.
items.why: Progress in recovery; McVay confirmation post-practice.
items.implication: Elite WR back in lineup; boosts Rams passing attack vs Eagles.
items.opportunity: Full target/route share restoration; Adams role may compress slightly.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers upgraded to full participants Thursday after prior limits.
items.why: Practice upgrade signals clear for Week 4.
items.implication: Full go expected for both; Ravens offense stabilized.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (TNF @CLE): 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; CLE allows 88+ rush yds/game; workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Elite recent usage + favorable matchup on short week.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (@NO): 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.opportunity: High target share, yards, TD potential.

items.text: ETR fresh ROS rankings have Kenneth Walker at overall #3; notable high placement amid early returns.
items.why: Updated ROS Top-150 post-Week 3; Walker stands out near elite tier.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold signal for Walker ROS value.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed placed on IR for season-ending neck surgery; not career-threatening.
items.why: Neck injury from Week 2; surgery confirmed by coach.
items.implication: GB WR depth chart permanent shift for 2026.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for Watson, Golden, others in committee.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has only six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst underperformers relative to opportunity.
items.why: Target volume, red-zone absence, aDOT data show inefficiency vs opportunity.
items.implication: Fade or sell-low candidate until role expands with Penix.
items.conflict: Berry also hates Pitts on similar usage.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 rankings and snaps/pace posted; focus on usage/pace for matchups like DAL@HOU up-tempo vs LAC@SEA slow.
items.why: Weekly rankings + snaps-pace analysis for opportunity identification.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (@SEA): RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage metrics + tough run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts (@NO): 16% career target share/34 ypg with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization.
items.why: Historically low production/role with Penix starter.

items.text: LOVE Trevor Lawrence (@CIN): 19+ FP in 8/9 recent; highest Week 4 O/U 51.5; prior big game vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Passing volume and TDs in high-total game.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson (@CHI): 36% target share last without Mitchell (likely out again); 78% catch rate, CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated target share with teammate out + matchup.
